page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. One main text column on the left with a woodcut initial. Narrow notes column on the right, with notes beside paragraphs 1, 2, 3 and 5. Catchword at the bottom right of the text block. Faint show-through from the reverse side is omitted.

main_text.p: Humidũ nativum,Humidum nativum est vel Insitum, vel Adventitium.
Insitum, à semine & sanguine menstruo ortum, corpori ab ipsa conformatione inest. Solet dici radicale & primigenium.Insitum seu radicale,
Adventitium.Adventitium insiti reparandi gratia ab alimentorum utiliore parte proficiscitur.
Radicale humidum ab infantia maximum est, minus ætate consistente, minimum in senectute: in causa est caloris innati absumtio; quæ quò longius progreditur, eò plus humidi depascitur.
Ut autem ab ipsa nativitate humidum radicale ad obitum usque decrescit; ita contra adventitium initio crescit, deinde consistit, postea unà cum radicali paulatim deficit.Os.
main_text.head: CAPVT XXXI. DE PARTIBUS ET CONIVNCTIONE OSSIVM.
main_text.p: Secundarium membrum est organum, quo anima mediatè & secundarió ad distinctas actiones utitur.

page.notes: The catchword "Estque" is the first word of the next page. The printed page number "221" is hard to read and may be "?21". The right-margin note "Os." is faint and uncertain. Faint ghost text across the page, and the faint marks at the bottom left and bottom right, are show-through and were left out. The initial S is a woodcut and is joined to "ecundarium" as "Secundarium". The heading is one head: CAPUT XXXI. with its title, with "CON-IUNCTIONE" joined across the line break.
